resources.string: This device does not allow creating a work profile right now
Stops screenshots and screen recording of apps in the space, and blanks them in Recents.
Hide notification content on lock screen
Notifications from the space show without their text while the phone is locked.
Copy and paste between the space and the rest of the phone is blocked in both directions.
Hides contacts in the space from contact search and caller ID outside it.
Some privacy settings could not be applied on this device
Every app in the space and all of its data will be permanently deleted. There is no backup and this cannot be undone.
Keep apps in a space of their own
Second Space is a separate, locked area of your phone. Apps you add live there with their own data and accounts, and need your lock to open.
Unlock with your Second Space lock to see your apps.
Nothing here yet. Open the ⋮ menu and choose Add apps.
Get apps from the Play Store
Opens the Play Store inside Second Space
Preparing the Play Store. Tap again in a moment.
If lock, freeze or privacy changes stop working, check the connection, then repair the space. If it can\'t be reached, pause and resume Work apps in Quick Settings.
Second Space is not reachable. Pause and resume Work apps in Quick Settings.
Could not reach Second Space. Pause and resume Work apps in Quick Settings, then try again.
Could not reach Second Space. Setting not changed.

When Second Space locks, its apps are hidden and stopped, and nothing arrives until you open it again. It locks when the screen turns off. While open, a small notification keeps the lock listener alive. If Cloak loses its pairing while apps are hidden, they cannot be shown again without deleting the space.
Also hide apps on restart (may not finish)

Tries to hide the apps when the phone shuts down or restarts. Android only allows a short time for this, so with many or heavy apps it may not finish. Apps are hidden again after the restart either way, and always need the work PIN.
Hide apps again after a restart (recommended)

After the phone restarts, Cloak hides the apps that were open before. If this is off, they stay visible until you open Cloak, which then hides them and asks for the PIN again. They always need the work PIN either way.
Planned: also hide apps without a launcher icon. Not available yet.
Cloak cannot reach your Second Space

This copy of Cloak has lost its link to the space on this phone, most likely because Cloak\'s data was cleared. Your apps are still inside the space, but Cloak can no longer lock it, change its settings, or add and remove apps. The only way to start over is to remove the space in your phone\'s settings. That permanently deletes every app and all data in it.
Look for the work profile under Accounts or Work profile and remove it. The wording differs by phone. When it is gone, come back here to create a new space.
Could not open settings. Open them yourself and look for the work profile.

Another app already manages the work profile on this phone, and Android allows only one. Second Space cannot create its own until that one is removed. Remove it in the app that manages it, or in your phone\'s settings under Accounts or Work profile, then come back here.
If this profile was created by Cloak, restart your phone once and check again. Cloak repairs its own setup when the phone starts.
Recover with recovery token (not available yet)
Optional. A code you keep yourself that lets you reconnect Cloak to this space if Cloak\'s data is ever cleared.
A recovery token is a code only you hold. If Cloak\'s data is ever cleared, entering it lets you reconnect to your existing space instead of deleting it and losing everything inside.

Cloak does not store the token anywhere. If you lose it, you lose this option, and the only way out is to delete the space. Anyone who has the token and your work PIN could take over the space, so keep it private.
A recovery token is set for this space.
The current token will stop working. If Cloak\'s data is cleared later, the only way out will be to delete the space.

Write it down, or export it to a file in a place you choose. It is shown only now and cannot be shown again. There is no copy button on purpose, because copied text can be read by other apps and keyboards.
Type the token back in, or import the file you exported, to prove your copy works. The token is not shown on this screen.
That is not a valid token. Check for typos.
This is a valid token, but not the one just created.
No valid token found in that file
Could not reach Second Space. Try again.
Second Space should have shown a short confirmation. If you did not see one, create the token again, because Cloak has no way to check from here.
Recovery is not set up for this space
Unlock Second Space first, then try again
Too many failed attempts. Try again later
Recovery request expired. Try again, and check the phone\'s date and time
The recovery token did not match
Recovery needs a work lock. Set one first
Second Space is paired with this Cloak
Confirm your work PIN to reconnect Cloak
Enter the recovery token you saved, or import the file you exported. Second Space will then ask for your work PIN before it reconnects.
Second Space is unlocked and ready.
Work apps are paused. Turn them on first.
Second Space is locked. Unlock it first.
Turn on or unlock Second Space
After you tap Recover, enter your work PIN when asked. If the token is wrong or not set up, Second Space will say so.
Enter your work PIN when asked. When Second Space shows "paired with this Cloak", tap It worked. If it showed an error or you cancelled, tap Try again.
Could not reach Second Space. Turn on Work apps and try again.
This side has no folder picker. If this is Second Space, open Cloak, go to Settings, tap Enable folder picker in Second Space, and try again.
Nothing to copy. The shared items could not be read.
Access to the source was lost. Files copied so far are kept.
Share from Second Space to personal apps
Lets apps in Second Space show your personal apps in their share menu. This applies to every app in the space, not only Cloak. Sharing from personal apps into the space always works.
Choosing a folder inside Second Space needs a system file app there. This turns on the one your phone uses.
Enable folder picker in Second Space
Requested. Reopen the transfer screen and try again
No system folder picker found on this phone
Copy or move files and folders between your personal storage and Second Space. The folder you copy into is chosen on the receiving side, so each side only ever picks folders it owns.
Pick what to send here. You then choose the destination folder inside Second Space.
Pick what to send inside Second Space. You then choose the destination folder here.
Could not read the selection, so nothing was sent
Could not reach the other side. Check that Second Space is unlocked and try again
This phone has no file picker for that
Second Space has no file picker. Open Cloak, go to Settings and tap Enable folder picker in Second Space
Move (remove the originals after a verified copy)

Originals are removed only when every file was copied and its size checked, and the source has not changed since you picked it. Cancelled or partly failed moves remove nothing. Removal happens the next time you open Cloak.
Move copies first, then removes the originals only after checking file counts and sizes on both sides. If anything differs, the originals stay.
Copied. Open Cloak to remove the originals.
Picking files inside Second Space needs a system file app there. Enable it in Settings if the picker does not open.
